fields.why: For the four insurance groups (age <65), 'did not differ by ... health insurance coverage type' under subgroup Z-tests states a null finding for every pair, with no referent named, like the QuickStats 'all other differences' case. A's 'per-group vs referent only' has no referent to rest on.
Every subgroup comparison uses prevalence directly age-standardized to the 2000 population, so age also acts as an adjustment variable (covariate). B omitted it.
The article does not say how race/ethnicity was defined; the brief allows either omitting basis or giving 'not stated'.
